subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical Chinese locale IDs from `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` to `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs publish metadata, generated i18n artifacts, and saved preferences?
rationale: The change is semantically reasonable but crosses public locale values, persisted browser state, generated artifacts, docs publishing, and stable CLI onboarding docs, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
options.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one reviewed change.

options.title: Keep current region IDs
options.body: Treat `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as OpenClaw's stable user-facing locale contract and continue improving terminology under those IDs.

options.title: Defer to broader i18n planning
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers settle the long-term localization contract and docs publish shape.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-ID migration
recommendation.body: Migrate runtime, wizard, docs publish metadata, generated assets, tests, docs, and saved browser preferences together in one reviewed change.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans user-facing docs and the CLI setup contract, and recent merged wizard/docs history points to this owner for the product-contract call.
